item.title: Andrew Ng: Build AI-native engineering teams, not AI-using ones (The Batch #376)
item.description: Ng's People, Projects, Platforms, Processes framework: leaders must build themselves, and with build cost collapsed the bottlenecks are now spec, context and coordination.

item.title: Cory Doctorow: Critique and writing — LLM feedback is no substitute for a peer workshop
item.description: Getting editorial notes on your own work is distinctly inferior to critiquing other writers' work — that's what actually builds your own critical instincts.
